mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_order ( order_no, order_type, user_id, interpreter_id, service_type, group_size, start_time, end_time, total_amount, paid_amount, status, remark, phone ) VALUES ( #{orderNo}, #{orderType}, #{userId}, #{interpreterId}, #{serviceType}, #{groupSize}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{totalAmount}, #{paidAmount}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{phone} )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM biz_order WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

SELECT o.id, o.order_no, o.user_id, u.nickname AS user_nickname, u.avatar AS user_avatar, u.phone AS user_phone, u.email AS user_email, o.interpreter_id, i.nickname AS interpreter_nickname, i.avatar AS interpreter_avatar, p.id AS profile_id, o.service_type, o.group_size, o.start_time, o.end_time, o.total_amount, o.paid_amount, o.status, o.remark, o.phone AS order_phone, o.cancel_reason, o.cancelled_by, o.is_commented, o.create_time FROM biz_order o LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON o.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN sys_user i ON o.interpreter_id = i.id LEFT JOIN interpreter_profile p ON o.interpreter_id = p.user_id WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} AND o.order_type = 1 AND o.deleted = 0 ORDER BY o.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_order WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND order_type = 1 AND deleted = 0

SELECT o.id, o.order_no, o.user_id, u.nickname AS user_nickname, u.avatar AS user_avatar, u.phone AS user_phone, u.email AS user_email, o.interpreter_id, i.nickname AS interpreter_nickname, i.avatar AS interpreter_avatar, p.id AS profile_id, o.service_type, o.group_size, o.start_time, o.end_time, o.total_amount, o.paid_amount, o.status, o.remark, o.phone AS order_phone, o.cancel_reason, o.cancelled_by, o.is_commented, o.create_time FROM biz_order o LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON o.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN sys_user i ON o.interpreter_id = i.id LEFT JOIN interpreter_profile p ON o.interpreter_id = p.user_id WHERE o.interpreter_id = #{interpreterId} AND o.order_type = 1 AND o.deleted = 0 ORDER BY o.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_order WHERE interpreter_id = #{interpreterId} AND order_type = 1 AND deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE biz_order SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
